facts.fact: KNBS's July 2025 announcement of the second statistics strategy says the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics was established through the Statistics Act of 2006 (Cap. 112, Rev. 2022) as the principal agency for official statistics and coordination of the national statistical system, and that the Act was amended in 2019 to provide for the statistics function at county level.
